title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdiction of Disputes over Liability for Damages Caused by Application for Property Preservation during Litigation

articles.content_en:
August 1, 2017

Supreme People's Court

Reply on the Issue of Jurisdiction over Disputes concerning Liability for Damage Caused by the Application of Property Preservation in Litigation

Fa Shi [2017] No. 14

Higher People's Court of Zhejiang Province:

Your Request for Instructions on the Issue of Jurisdiction over Disputes concerning Liability for Damage Caused by the Application of Property Preservation in Litigation ((2015) Zhe Li Ta Zi No. 91) has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:

To facilitate litigation by the parties, actions brought by the respondent or interested party in property preservation in litigation in accordance with Article 105 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China regarding disputes concerning liability for damage caused by the application of property preservation in litigation shall be under the jurisdiction of the People's Court that rendered the ruling on property preservation in litigation.

This reply.
